children: Pilgrim’s Pride priced a €500 million offering of 4.750% senior notes due 2034, expected to close Sept. 23, 2026.
Priced €500M aggregate principal of 4.750% senior notes due 2034; sale expected to close Sept. 23, 2026.
Net proceeds intended for general corporate purposes, including funding the Walkers Deli & Sausage acquisition.
Offering not conditioned on closing of the Walkers acquisition; customary closing conditions apply.
Notes are Rule 144A/Reg S private placement to qualified institutional buyers and certain non‑U.S. persons.
